title: Logistics waybill input
description: Input for the logistics waybill templates. Data only; never code or expressions.

tracking_code.description: Waybill number. Encoded as the Code 128 barcode and printed under it.

order_code.description: Optional order number printed under the barcode.

sort_code.description: Hub or route sorting code printed in large type, for example HN299-00-00-01.

parcel_contents.description: What is inside the parcel, for example 1 paper box.

weight.description: Maximum weight as text, for example 1,593g.

cod_amount.description: Cash to collect from the recipient, as text with currency, for example 194,000 VND. Leave empty for prepaid.

qr_value.description: Text encoded in the QR code. Usually the tracking code or a tracking URL.

doc_language.description: Language of fixed labels inside the document. Independent of the UI language.
